text: 9月29日，财政部、中国人民银行等部门发布《关于实施居民购房贷款贴息政策的通知》，明确自今年10月1日起在全国范围内实施居民购房贷款贴息政策，减轻新购买首套住房家庭的商业性个人住房贷款利息负担。截至10月10日，居民购房贷款贴息政策在全国正式实施已满十日。记者注意到，在政策出台后，各家国有大行积极响应，第一时间推动政策落地见效。“十一”假期，全国多个省市顺利落地首批房贷贴息业务，众多符合条件的刚需购房者率先享受政策红利，置业压力得到切实缓解。（金融时报）
text_en: On September 29, the Ministry of Finance, the People's Bank of China and other departments issued the "Notice on Implementing the Interest Subsidy Policy for Resident Housing Purchase Loans," specifying that starting from October 1 this year, the interest subsidy policy for resident housing purchase loans will be implemented nationwide, to ease the interest burden of commercial personal housing loans for families newly purchasing their first homes. As of October 10, the interest subsidy policy for resident housing purchase loans has been officially implemented nationwide for ten full days. The reporter noted that after the policy was introduced, major state-owned banks responded actively and moved quickly to ensure the policy took effect. During the National Day holiday, many provinces and cities across the country successfully implemented the first batch of housing loan interest subsidy business, and many eligible first-time homebuyers were among the first to enjoy the policy benefits, with their home-purchasing pressure effectively eased. (Financial News)
